chunks: And that is how We requite him who is extravagant and does not believe the signs of his Lord; and surely the punishment of the Hereafter is far more severe and persistent.
ai.seo_question: What is the nature of divine punishment for those who disbelieve and are extravagant?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Taa-Haa, this verse concludes the narrative of Pharaoh to illustrate the ultimate fate of the arrogant disbeliever who rejected divine signs. Shia scholarship highlights the dual nature of this recompense: 'ashadd' (more severe) refers to the intensity of the pain, while 'abqa' (more enduring) underscores its eternity, serving as a practical warning for believers to maintain steadfastness in faith despite worldly trials.
